facets.label: Year of study
facets.help: Which year(s) of a program an award is open to.

facets.label: Program
facets.help: Faculty-wide entries ('Engineering Faculty - All Programs') match every program in that faculty.

facets.label: Restricted to
facets.help: Awards reserved for a specific group. Leave blank to see everything; pick a group to see only its awards.

facets.label: Term
facets.help: The term an award is applied for or paid in — not a deadline.

facets.label: Source
facets.help: Which institution or organisation published the award.

facets.label: Application status
facets.help: Awards whose application window has closed are hidden by default. Many are annual and will reopen, so they are kept and can be shown — sources that publish no status at all are always shown.

facets.label: How you apply
facets.help: Nomination-only and institution-mediated awards cannot be applied for directly, however well you match them.

facets.label: Award value
facets.help: Only awards that state a dollar figure. Setting this hides awards whose value is not published.

facets.label: Has a known deadline
facets.help: Many sources publish a prose window rather than a date.

facets.label: Your province
facets.help: Residency requirements, e.g. 12 months in Alberta.

facets.label: Minimum grade required
facets.help: Only awards that state a grade requirement.
